items.title: Sakana AI lists a Namazu Small release on its blog
items.summary_en: A search-result digest of the Sakana AI blog lists a Namazu Small release dated 25 November 2026. Namazu is described as Sakana's Japanese-focused LLM, post-trained mainly for Japanese users from an open model. No details such as size, benchmarks or licence could be read.
items.source_name: Sakana AI Blog (index page, seen only via search snippet)
items.notes: sakana.ai could not be fetched (host not allowed in session network). The date and description come from a web-search summary and are unverified. The post-specific URL was not found, so the blog index is cited. The orchestrator should check the original post.

items.title: Sakana Marlin update adds research modes and a revised slide output
items.summary_en: A search-result digest reports a Marlin update dated 26 November 2026. Marlin is Sakana's first commercial product, an autonomous research assistant. The update reportedly adds new research modes and a revised slide output.
items.source_name: Sakana AI (Marlin launch page; the update post URL was not found)
items.notes: The cited URL is the original Marlin launch page, not the update post. The 26 November date comes from a search summary and is unverified. sakana.ai could not be fetched.

items.title: Sawara pre-training timeline reported after the 26 October symposium (background)
items.summary_en: Search summaries of Sakana's 26 October 2026 symposium say it set out three AI sovereignty pillars. These are AI-assisted pre-training, Japanese and business post-training through Namazu, and orchestration through Fugu. The planned homegrown foundation model, provisionally named Sawara, is reported to start pre-training around late 2026. A small model is targeted for spring 2027, with larger versions later.
items.source_name: Sakana AI Blog (index page, seen only via search snippet)
items.notes: This is outside the collection window and is included only as context for the Namazu and Sawara items. The two searches disagree on pre-training start (November 2026 in one, December 2026 in the other), so the start date is unresolved. The Sawara name is described as provisional. Not verified against a primary page.

coverage_note: Direct access to sakana.ai failed because the host is not in the session's allowed network domains, so no primary page was read. Only web-search snippets were available. They suggest Sakana published a Namazu Small release (about 25 Nov) and a Marlin update (about 26 Nov) inside the window, but these are unverified and carry secondary-source confidence. Dates in the snippets were partly relative. Other recent Sakana items seen in search results (Fugu-Ultra v1.1 with a Claude Code interface, Fugu-Cyber, Fugu Max on 11 Sep, the Security Research Group, the RSI Lab and Aquarium on 23 Oct) have no confirmed dates inside 18-28 Nov and were left out. Allow sakana.ai in the network settings and re-run to confirm.
notes: No other targets covered. A single search snippet mentioned Google's investment in Sakana (eWEEK); it is a secondary source with no date seen, so it was not included.
